levels.name: Crucitorn
levels.description: A technique of extreme discipline, allowing the Jedi to transcend physical pain and trauma. They use the Force to suppress shock and agony so they can continue fighting to protect others.

levels.name: Crucitorn

levels.effect: You remain conscious automatically regardless of negative HP (until you reach -5xHP, at which point you die). You feel no pain whatsoever.
